def sentiment(
    text       = None,
    confidence = False
    ):
    """
    This function accepts a string text input. It calculates the sentiment of
    the text, "pos" or "neg". By default, it returns this calculated sentiment.
    If selected, it returns a tuple of the calculated sentiment and the
    classificaton confidence.
    """
    # Import libraries
    import pandas as pd
    from textblob import TextBlob
    from textblob import Sentiment
    from textblob.sentiments import NaiveBayesAnalyzer

    # Create a dataframe
    df = pd.DataFrame({'text':[text]})

    # Create a sentiment analyzer
    analyzer = Sentiment(NaiveBayesAnalyzer())

    # Apply the sentiment analyzer to the dataframe
    df['sentiment'] = df['text'].apply(analyzer.analyze)

    # Extract the sentiment
    sentiment = df['sentiment'].iloc[0]

    # Extract the classification confidence
    if confidence:
        confidence = df['sentiment'].iloc[0].classification.confidence
        sentiment = (sentiment, confidence)

    # Return the sentiment
    return sentiment

def sentiment_polarity(
    text       = None,
    confidence = False
    ):
    """
    This function accepts a string text input. It calculates the polarity of
    the text, "positive" or "negative". By default, it returns this calculated
    polarity. If selected, it returns a tuple of the calculated polarity and
    the classificaton confidence.
    """

    # Import libraries
    import pandas as pd
    from textblob import TextBlob
    from textblob import Sentiment
    from textblob.sentiments import NaiveBayesAnalyzer

    # Create a dataframe
    df = pd.DataFrame({'text':[text]})

    # Create a sentiment analyzer
    analyzer = Sentiment(NaiveBayesAnalyzer())

    # Apply the sentiment analyzer to the dataframe
    df['sentiment'] = df['text'].apply(analyzer.analyze)

    # Extract the polarity
    polarity = df['sentiment'].iloc[0].polarity

    # Extract the classification confidence
    if confidence:
        confidence = df['sentiment'].iloc[0].classification.confidence
        polarity = (polarity, confidence)

    # Return the polarity
    return polarity
